profile.headline: Software Engineer@Atlassian
profile.summary:
Principal Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience leading teams in architecting and delivering scalable, highly available cloud-native solutions. Adept at driving cross-team collaboration to align technical solutions with business objectives. Proven ability to optimize distributed systems -- achieving a 70% reduction in cloud costs and 80% improvement in data processing time. Passionate about engineering excellence, team mentorship, and delivering high impact product and services.

Specialties: Java, Docker, Kafka, Zookeeper, HDFS,  Apache, Tomcat, REST, oData, Kubernetes, HANA, Oracle, mySQL,  Hibernate, JBoss, Jenkins, Maven, Gradle, TeamCity,  Ant , SOAP,   Spring, Javascript, Mobile application, Wireless protocols and Internet services, Android, Linux, Database Design & SQL.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Workday’s Core Services team to develop OMS (Object Management Services) — a foundational cluster of services that functions as an in-memory database and hosts the business logic powering all Workday applications.

As a technical leader, I guided the team in the following key areas:
* Developing highly availabile distributed data Conversion services to keep tenant data refrshed. 
* Enhancing Tenant Lifecycle capabilities to support seamless weekly platform upgrades. 

Key Achievements:
* Led the design and deployment of a distributed conversion service, achieving an 85%+
reduction in processing time, while maintaining the same data volume and improving
scalability.
* Improved failover reliability by designing highly available conversion services that
eliminated the 8-hour node transition delay during failures, enabling seamless and resilient
service continuity.
* Optimized Workday OMS data purging, reducing processing time from 2 hours to 10
minutes for millions of records.
* Partnered with across function teams to redesign the tenant loading process to improve concurrency and resilience under high load, significantly reducing failures and enabling the team to reach 99.9% availability.
* Enhanced engineering runbooks, improving incident handling efficiency and system
reliability.
